policies.title: Malaysia ordinary passports: Panama short tourist visit visa-free
policies.summary: Malaysia's current Lima Embassy guidance expressly says Malaysian passport holders do not require a visa for Panama tourism of up to 90 days.
conditions: Tourism only, for a stay not exceeding 90 days.
Use a valid Malaysian ordinary passport with at least six months' validity; the guidance also requires hotel booking and at least USD 500 proof of economic solvency.
Work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic, official, emergency and other special-document routes, carrier requirements and final admission are not established by this policy.
